newsitem.title: USA: Rexrodt says told G7 Germany to make euro grade.
newsitem.headline: Rexrodt says told G7 Germany to make euro grade.

text.p: German economics minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Friday evening that he had told Group of Seven finance ministers that Germany would meet the entry criteria to join European economic and monetary union in 1999.
"I said for Germany that we would reach the criteria and Strauss-Kahn said the same for France," Rexrodt said, referring to France's Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn.
Rexrodt added that the United States had made clear in the talks that it now also expected the euro to be launched on time.
"The previous scepticism is no longer there," he said.

Countries which want to join the euro in 1999 have to meet targets on interest and exchange rates, inflation, deficits and public debt this year. Both Germany and France are finding difficulty in reaching the fiscal criteria.
